title: Unchanged tree: m = n, left siblings only

sentences.text: A CCF consistency proof establishes that the tree of `m` transactions with root `R_m` is a prefix of the tree of `n` transactions with root `R_n`, where `0 < m < n`: every transaction of the older tree is at the same position in the newer tree.

reading_b_size_free.rule_text: 4: "where 0 < m < n" (a path of left siblings only folds both roots to one: m = n)

tree_sizes_note: older_size: the size of the ledger tree whose root older_root is; newer_size: the seqno of the receipt's ccf.v1 txid 2.24, the tree size its signature covers as measured on CCF 7.0.17 with leaf 0 counted (not stated by -05)

reading_b_size_aware.rule_text: 4: "where 0 < m < n" (a path of left siblings only folds both roots to one: m = n)

construction: anchor node(16, 24) of the 24-leaf tree and its one left sibling node(0, 16); both folds give R_24

provenance.note: the service's own COSE_Sign1 over R_24 from the fixture, its unprotected header replaced; the proofs are computed from the ledger's leaves
